sentence_1_it: Tom non sa come mi sento.
sentence_1_en: Tom doesn't know how I feel.
sentence_2_it: Gli ha chiesto come si stava sentendo suo padre.
sentence_2_en: She asked him how his father was feeling.
sentence_3_it: Tom e Mary non sono intelligenti come sembrano.
sentence_3_en: Tom and Mary aren't as smart as they look.

sentence_1_en: You're perfect the way you are.
sentence_2_it: Com'è difficile, amare ed essere saggio allo stesso tempo.
sentence_2_en: How difficult a thing it is, to love, and to be wise, and both at once.
sentence_3_it: Non sono pesanti com'erano una volta.
sentence_3_en: They aren't as heavy as they used to be.
